choices.why: This light birch table is 125 cm wide, which seats four and fits the open floor beside the kitchenette, and its pale tone suits the kitchen's light wood and the Nordic look.
These simple black wooden chairs come from the same Nordic family as the table and give the black-on-light-wood contrast the user asked for.
A plain white bell pendant blends with the white walls and ceiling and keeps the dining corner simple and Scandinavian.
The white body disappears against the white wall, and its pale wood fronts repeat the tones of the table and the kitchen cabinets.

answer.why: Pale wood, white and black accents create a light, cohesive Nordic dining corner that continues the kitchenette's light wood and white finishes and sits well on the gray floor.
